title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Duplicate tool names in subagent invocation
body:
DESCRIPTION:
When invoking the Task tool with any subagent type (Explore, Plan, etc.), the API returns a 400 error with message "tools: Tool names must be unique." This makes it impossible to use specialized agents for code exploration or planning.

ERROR MESSAGE:
API Error: 400 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"invalid_request_error","message":"tools: Tool names must be unique."},"request_id":"req_011CUfrcXHBhAYpNDur1paof"}

STEPS TO REPRODUCE:
1. Invoke Task tool with any subagent_type parameter:
   - subagent_type: "Explore" or "Plan"
2. Error occurs immediately on invocation

EXPECTED BEHAVIOR:
Task tool should successfully create a sub-agent and execute the requested exploration or planning task.

ACTUAL BEHAVIOR:
Request fails with "tools must be unique" error. All Task tool invocations with subagents fail.

ENVIRONMENT:
- Platform: darwin (macOS)
- Terminal: Cursor
- Claude Code Version: 2.0.30
- Feedback ID: 83622f0d-b349-423a-a664-90b7b60b5375
- Node modules path: /Users/yusuf/.claude/local/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/
